title: El Viajante de Sombrerete, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: viajante-sombrerete (MAJESTIC): tienda de abarrotes antigua en Sombrerete, Zacatecas, y el despacho de la hacienda. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.AURELIO_MONTES: Mexican man, a traveling cloth salesman who is secretly the patrón of the region, 62 years old, light-brown skin, short salt-and-pepper hair, a neat grey mustache, calm sharp eyes, a worn beige travel jacket over a light-blue shirt, brown trousers, dusty brown shoes, a small grey fedora, his hands empty.
chars.REMIGIO_PENA: Mexican man, owner of the general store, 55 years old, brown skin, balding with black hair on the sides, a round face, a thin black mustache, a white short-sleeve shirt with a brown cardigan vest, grey trousers, black shoes, reading glasses hanging on a cord around his neck, his hands empty.
chars.BALTASAR_RUELAS: Mexican man, the store owner's partner, 48 years old, light skin, slicked black hair, a sharp hard face, a short black beard, a dark-red western shirt, a black leather jacket, jeans, black boots, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_TIENDASOMBRERETE: Interior of an old general store in Sombrerete, Zacatecas, in the afternoon: a long dark wooden counter, shelves full of jars, sacks of beans and corn, an old cast-iron wood stove in the corner, hanging lanterns, a front door open to a sunny cobblestone street, dusty warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
locs.LOC_DESPACHOSOMBRERETE: Office of an old wealthy hacienda in Zacatecas, in the afternoon: a huge carved dark-wood desk, a tall carved wooden chair like a throne behind it, stone walls, a big window with sunlight, bookshelves, an old map of the region framed on the wall, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
